senses.gloss:
gocara (EI 15; Chamba), pasture land.
 (LP), a tax for allowing cattle to graze in the pasture land.
gocaraka (Chamba), pasture land; same as gocara.
gocarman (IE 8-6; EI 28; CITD), an area of land often regarded as equal to ten nivartanas although the exact area varied in different ages and localities.
Gocchakapati (EI 28), official designation of uncertain import. Cf. the Bengali family name Guchāita 〈 Gochāyati 〈 Gocchakapati.
